description.value: The Bench Market is a long-established South Okanagan food destination in Penticton combining a full-service eatery, espresso bar, and artisan grocery under one roof, built around a strong commitment to local sourcing — BC free-run eggs, ethically raised meats, and seasonal produce delivered directly from regional farms. It has been featured in the Vancouver Sun, Washington Post, Food Network, and numerous travel publications, and the Penticton Herald noted it had been 'brewing strong after 15 years.' Touring cyclists can dine in, grab takeaway, or stock up on house-made granolas, artisan goods, and take-and-bake Bench-made meals from the market shelves.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is complete and current, confirming the business is an active dine-in and takeout restaurant/market at 368 Vancouver Ave, Penticton, with phone 250-492-2222. Takeout is explicitly confirmed ('Dine in - or takeaway!' plus online ordering and curbside pickup). Vegan-labeled menu items and gluten-aware options are explicitly named throughout the menu page. No bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, water refill, or charging are mentioned anywhere on the site, so those remain null. OSM had no address or phone, so both are sourced from the website.
concerns: OSM record contains no address or phone; both values sourced from the website.
OSM opening_hours tag conflicts with the hours stated in the website footer — OSM hours data may be outdated.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Well-established, much-featured eatery and artisan market in central Penticton with explicit takeout, extensive vegan/GF menu, and local-sourcing ethos — a strong natural stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu page labels multiple items 'Vegan' (Vegan Bench Breakfast Plate, Vegan Power Cereal, Vegan Bowl, Veggie Benny, Vegan Benny, etc.) and states 'Gluten-aware options available. Please ask when ordering.'
